manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
